name: DRD Manufacturing — Executive Summary & Deep Analysis (C-suite)

content.executiveSummary: Manufacturing Digital Readiness: Overall maturity 4.1/7 vs target 5.5/7 (gap: 1.4). Strongest areas: Digital Products (5.0) and Digital Processes (3.8). Critical gaps in AI Maturity (2.0) and Culture of Transformation (2.9). Investment required: €2.8M over 18 months. Expected ROI: 185% within 3 years. Key recommendation: Accelerate data governance and MLOps capabilities as foundation for AI-driven manufacturing excellence.
recommendations: Axis 3: Digital Business Models — Gap Assessment
Axis 5: Culture of Transformation — Organizational Readiness
Axis 7: AI Maturity — Current State & Potential
